name: RippleGrid-TS-TW
title: Ripple Grid
description: A WebGL grid of thin white lines on black keeps rippling outward, brightest at the middle and fading into darkness at the edges. The pointer adds a local wave so the grid bends around it.
use: A dark tech or AI hero needs a spatial grid that reacts to the pointer.
avoid: Thin bright lines on black are hard to read text over and glare on bright screens.
a11y: A canvas backdrop with no labels; the endless ripple ignores reduced-motion settings. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A white wireframe grid sits on black, bowing outward from the centre so it reads like a stretched net. Lines are brightest in the middle and fade to black toward the corners.
behaves: A pulse keeps travelling out from the centre, bending the grid and letting it spring back. Under the pointer a local wave shifts the lines so the net warps around the cursor.
customise: Colour, rainbow mode, ripple strength, cell size, line thickness, glow, fade, vignette and rotation are all props.
weight: heavy: A full-screen shader is redrawn on every animation frame.
demo: White grid on black with 10px cells, thickness 15 and mouse warp enabled.
polishWhy: Crisp, convincing ripple with a bright centre; the grid fades early and only one colour shows.
